description: As a Technical Lead at VueData Technologies, I have spearheaded several key projects, focusing on data analytics and automation for a major web browser's shopping features and other applications. I led a team to automate coupon testing for e-commerce platforms by designing and implementing Azure-based pipelines, utilizing Azure Functions, Docker, Selenium, and GPT for efficient coupon validation. I also managed petabyte-scale datasets in Azure Data Lake, optimizing Scope scripts (U-SQL) for performance, and deploying solutions through Azure ADF pipelines, integrating data with Power BI for visualizations. Additionally, I developed back-end services for cross-platform applications, ensuring secure and scalable systems using Node.js, CosmosDB, and Azure, delivering high-quality products for diverse markets. My leadership has resulted in significant improvements in process automation and overall system efficiency.

I worked on various projects, including developing modular enterprise applications for a national deposit insurance scheme, where I utilized Kotlin, Java, and MariaDB to ensure scalability and security across systems. I also coordinated both backend and front-end development with ReactJS to streamline client operations. Additionally, for an enterprise hardware company, I developed a platform to track and optimize server sustainability, using sensors to monitor CPU, GPU, and system metrics, and built hub-spoke models to centralize global server data for tracking and visualization. These roles involved working on critical enterprise and sustainability solutions, ensuring system reliability and performance.

In my role as a Software Developer across various insurance projects, I focused on developing and integrating critical applications. At GoDB Tech, I created scalable REST APIs for a life insurance platform, facilitating seamless quote and policy creation while collaborating on database management using SQL Server and Docker. I automated motor insurance claims processing, integrating REST and SOAP APIs with client-facing systems, and developed backend services for claims estimation, settlement, and salvage collection. My experience also includes payment gateway integration for an insurance provider using Java HTTP Client and developing salary processing applications for a large business group, where I integrated REST and SOAP APIs for both back-office and user applications. Additionally, I developed motor, medical, and home insurance applications, contributing to comprehensive insurance solutions.
